status: v0.2 — colors and type locked by Kevin 2026-10-28. Claude's earlier palette and type candidates discarded.

palette.name: Coral
palette.usage: Accent in general marketing, sparse. May be used as a primary color when appropriate (still rare). App is separate.

palette.name: Sea
palette.usage: May be used as a primary color when appropriate (still rare). Accent otherwise.

palette.name: Stone
palette.usage: Primary dark field, text on light

rules: Coral is used sparingly as an accent in general marketing materials.
Both Coral and Sea can be used as primary colors when appropriate. This should still be somewhat rare overall.
The app is a little different when it comes to color use. Do not apply marketing color rules to the app without checking.
Never apply brand colors to photography as a tint, overlay, or duotone.

layout.the_frame: The primary visual identifier. A rigid container that affords wide internal content variation while remaining branded. Metaphor: a regulated system (the nervous system + Neuvana) affords internal sway (a rich, full life). Order in the container, life in the content.
layout.whitespace: Always present when possible, including on social. No full bleed.

data_visualization: A first-class brand surface. Real data only (HRV charts, real waveforms). No decorative or fake data.
